scope: Additive CIN-ATL final-source gate after the first focused official-source follow-up. Reuses the bound Sunday inactive and transaction inventory. The official team box-score route was present but had not populated a final box score, participation table or official gamebook at the observation cutoff. No exact final, departure boundary, exposure, replacement workload, player value, injury loss, carried rating or issued Week 9 fair is inferred.

sources.finding: The official Bengals game route was available, but its returned box-score, team-stat and player-stat fields were unpopulated and it did not expose a final official gamebook. It did not support an exact final or complete paired final inventory at the observation cutoff.

The official NFL game-center route did not return a stable final-state/gamebook payload suitable for the governed exact-final and participation inventory. No live or partial score is promoted to an official final.

The completed Sunday pregame review binds the final inactive lists and Atlanta transaction/reserve context. Those facts are reused without changing their original receipt or adding a numerical conclusion.
